CREATE TABLE distribution_inbox_devices (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	owner_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pairing_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	pairing_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	claim_request_id VARCHAR(36), 
	credential_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	credential_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	rate_buckets JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inbox_device_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','active','revoked','expired')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inbox_device_revision CHECK (revision >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (pairing_digest)
)

CREATE TABLE distribution_inbox_receipts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	owner_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(36), 
	payload_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	platform VARCHAR(60), 
	title VARCHAR(300), 
	reported_account VARCHAR(60), 
	result VARCHAR(24), 
	reason_code VARCHAR(32), 
	public_url TEXT, 
	canonical_url TEXT, 
	url_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	normalizer_version VARCHAR(16), 
	content_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	label_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id BIGINT, 
	module VARCHAR(8), 
	scope_id BIGINT, 
	article_id BIGINT, 
	article_version INTEGER, 
	article_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	published_account VARCHAR(60), 
	verification_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	history JSONB NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_inbox_device_event UNIQUE (device_id, event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inbox_receipt_state CHECK (state IN ('pending','active','archived','deleted')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inbox_label_state CHECK (label_state IN ('pending','active','revoked')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inbox_receipt_size CHECK (revision >= 0 AND content_bytes >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inbox_assignment CHECK ((label_state = 'active' AND state = 'active' AND tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND module IN ('seo','geo')) OR (label_state <> 'active' AND tenant_id IS NULL AND module IS NULL AND scope_id IS NULL AND article_id IS NULL)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES distribution_inbox_devices (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
CREATE INDEX ix_inbox_devices_owner ON distribution_inbox_devices (owner_user_id, state)
CREATE INDEX ix_inbox_receipts_owner_state ON distribution_inbox_receipts (owner_user_id, state)
CREATE INDEX ix_inbox_receipts_owner_url ON distribution_inbox_receipts (owner_user_id, url_hash)
CREATE INDEX ix_inbox_receipts_target ON distribution_inbox_receipts (tenant_id, module, scope_id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_inbox_active_link ON distribution_inbox_receipts (tenant_id, module, COALESCE(scope_id, 0), url_hash) WHERE label_state = 'active' AND result = 'success' AND url_hash IS NOT NULL
